headline: Their top complaint is customer support, not the app.
comparison_note: This is the first month tracked, so there is no change from the month before yet. From November, each tile will show the change.
release_note: No October release stands out. The main versions all sit close to the month average. Reviews with no app version are the outlier, and are worth a look with the app team.

actions.title: Fix how tickets get closed
actions.text: Support comes up in [[complaints.share@code=support|pct]] of written complaints, ahead of late delivery. Users describe tickets closed with no fix. Audit a sample of closed tickets for real resolution.
actions.measure: support share of complaints in November

actions.title: Look at the late-night experience
actions.text: From 8 pm to midnight, the busiest part of the day per hour, the average is [[windows.avg_rating@window=night|dec2]] against [[windows.avg_rating@window=afternoon|dec2]] from noon to 8 pm. Check rider supply and delivery-time promises in that window.

actions.title: Reply to every 1-star review properly
actions.text: [[kpis.one_star_unreplied#0|int]] one-star reviews got no reply, and [[kpis.one_star_top_template_share#0|pct]] of replies to 1-star reviews open with the same line. Cover every 1-star review with a reply that names the issue.
actions.measure: 1-star reply rate and share of templated 1-star replies
